breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet and periodic. The agent correctly identified this conflict and, like the ground truth, removed the periodic condition, only specifying the Dirichlet boundary conditions: 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions u(0,t) = 0 and u(1,t) = 0'.
